basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old game enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I recently graduated with a degree in Environmental Science, but my passion for gaming, especially survival and open-world games, has been a constant companion. I love exploring new games and diving deep into their mechanics. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy playing tennis at the local courts or working on my coding skills. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, to catch up with gaming communities and learn something new. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in environmental science from my undergraduate studies, which has given me a solid understanding of ecological systems and sustainability. This knowledge often informs my gaming preferences, gravitating towards games with complex ecosystems or environmental challenges. I've also self-taught myself some basic programming to enhance my gaming experience through mods.
